# UltraHive

> UltraHive is a premium hexagonal falling-block puzzle by Ripsaw LLC. $2.99 one-time, no ads, no in-app purchases, on iPhone and Android.

Pieces drop onto a neon 11-column honeycomb and rotate in 60-degree steps. A hold piece and a ghost preview are included. Color chains of 8 or more cells clear. Classic mode has 25 intensity levels and five power-ups: place anywhere, clear a row, slow time, flip gravity, and shrink to a single hex. Hive Bits is 28 handcrafted puzzles with walls, moths, bee allies, and honey.

The iOS app launched on 2026-02-24. Version 1.6.0 was released on 2026-07-23. Game Center is used for leaderboards only. Family Sharing is available on Apple. Android has been on Google Play since 2026-09-10 and is fully offline. Scores and coins stay on the device. UltraHive does not collect personal data.

No rating, review count, award, or download total is stated on this site.

Most of the code was written with AI assistance (Claude Code). Game design, testing and tuning are by the developer, David Kon / Ripsaw LLC. The build note is at https://ultrahive.app/made-with-claude-code/. It does not state an origin for the art.

UltraHive is not affiliated with or endorsed by The Tetris Company. Tetris is a trademark of The Tetris Holding, LLC.

## Pages

- [How to play](https://ultrahive.app/how-to-play/): Rules for rotation, clears, power-ups, and Hive Bits. Also tips for chain clears (8 or more connected cells of the same color; cascading clears multiply the score), the 15 hex pieces from monohex to pentahex, and how the honeycomb differs from a square falling-block grid
- [Press kit](https://ultrahive.app/press/): Facts, screenshots, and contact for reviewers
- [Privacy policy](https://ultrahive.app/privacy/): No personal data collection. Canonical privacy URL
- [Hexagonal games like Tetris](https://ultrahive.app/hexagonal-tetris-games/): Comparison of hexagon block puzzles. UltraHive is our game. Other rows use only facts from each game's official page. No ratings or download counts
- [No ads](https://ultrahive.app/no-ads-puzzle-game/): $2.99 once, no ads, no in-app purchases. Android is fully offline. On iOS the game plays offline and Game Center is for leaderboards only
- [Built with Claude Code](https://ultrahive.app/made-with-claude-code/): Most of the code was written with Claude Code. Design, testing, and tuning are by David Kon / Ripsaw LLC
